_what: What the listener says about a listening (tools/listen-for-a-while/read-data/meeting-ledger.mjs, run from read-data/listen-for-a-while.mjs). `liveness`: a listening whose last heartbeat is older than stale_after_ms is reported finished, with no sweep. `false_text`: words a hearing model makes up out of silence; a line that is only one of them (at most max_words words) is left out. `job_states`: the typed states of a notes job with one plain sentence each and the controls each allows.

waiting.says: Listening has not heard enough yet to make notes.

noting.says: A model on this Mac is making the notes.

failed.says: The notes could not be made: {why}

stopped.says: Listening stopped before notes were made.
